evidence.claim: MOS sets ND_ENABLEINSIGHTSCOLLECTOR=false and ND_ENABLEGRAVATAR=false, and declares ND_GATRACKINGID as empty. These manifest-owned environment names cannot be replaced through MOS’s owner environment editor. Google Analytics initialises only when the server supplies a non-empty tracking ID. The package ships no configuration file setting one. External feature integrations remain available.
evidence.source: apps/navidrome/manifest.json; upstream ui/src/App.jsx and conf/configuration.go

evidence.claim: The install-time onlineMetadata checkbox defaults to true. When false, entrypoint.sh sets ND_AGENTS to an empty string unless the owner explicitly supplies ND_AGENTS. This selects local metadata without disabling the Last.fm or ListenBrainz scrobbler registrations. Plugins retain the upstream enabled default and none are preinstalled.
evidence.source: apps/navidrome/manifest.json and entrypoint.sh; upstream core/agents/agents.go and adapters/listenbrainz/agent.go

evidence.claim: The default metadata agents are Deezer, Last.fm and ListenBrainz. Deezer needs no owner API key; Last.fm needs server API credentials. ListenBrainz metadata uses MusicBrainz IDs without a user token, separately from sharing listening history.
evidence.source: Navidrome external integration documentation

evidence.claim: ListenBrainz listening-history sharing requires the user to enable Scrobble to ListenBrainz in Personal Settings and paste a user token. The source refuses NowPlaying and Scrobble submissions without a saved session key. Last.fm sharing likewise requires per-user authorisation in addition to server API credentials.
evidence.source: Navidrome scrobbling documentation and versioned adapters/listenbrainz/agent.go

evidence.claim: MOS sets ND_UILOGINBACKGROUNDURL to the shared MOS wallpaper SVG as an inline data URL. The upstream background handler is mounted only when the setting starts with a slash; this data URL therefore avoids both handler initialisation and its background-list download. The browser receives the image in the page configuration and needs no background-image HTTP request. MOS explicitly disables Gravatar.
evidence.source: apps/navidrome/manifest.json; upstream cmd/root.go, conf/configuration.go and consts/consts.go

evidence.claim: The human reviewer confirmed an active Bitwarden/Vaultwarden browser extension during the session. The browser-only request to the reviewer’s Vaultwarden host for /icons/127.0.0.1/icon.png is therefore attributed to that extension rather than Navidrome. This attribution combines the icon-request pattern with explicit reviewer confirmation; the HAR itself has no initiator metadata.

evidence.claim: Human review item 5: during the saved runtime session, external provider traffic totalled 151,504 bytes outbound and 2,664,854 bytes inbound, measured by captured frame lengths. Local browser traffic, logging-resolver traffic and the deliberate example.com control are excluded. Inbound traffic was 17.6 times outbound, consistent with fetching artwork and metadata. Counts include protocol overhead and acknowledgements. TLS was not decrypted, so destination and volume do not establish request contents or prove that no user data was transmitted. The human reviewer accepted these measurements on the condition that the provider traffic was only Deezer; DNS and TLS SNI identify only Deezer API hosts and cdn-images.dzcdn.net after excluding the labelled control.
evidence.source: Local human-review run: session-preserved.pcap, packets.tsv, packet-summary.json and flow-summary.json

security.claim: Navidrome 0.64.2 fixes download Content-Disposition filename sanitisation, initial-admin failure handling and password logging in that failure path. This package pins that release.

The wrapper creates the initial administrator through the native API on loopback before binding the externally routed server. Existing users are preserved. Music is mounted read-only, so the app cannot modify the drive library.

outbound.purpose: Looks up artist details and artwork when online metadata is enabled; Deezer sees the server address and music lookup terms.
Obtains an anonymous session used by the metadata adapter, without an owner Deezer account.
Requests metadata through Deezer’s alternate API used by the adapter.
Downloads artist artwork returned by Deezer’s metadata API.
Retrieves artist and track metadata when files carry MusicBrainz identifiers and online metadata is enabled. Listening-history submissions additionally require the user to connect a token.
Looks up similar artists and recordings by MusicBrainz identifiers when online metadata is enabled.
